title: Euclidean coefficient norm of k-covectors is induced by a linear isomorphism onto ℝ^N (Simon 6.1.2–1.5, Fact A)
statement: For all P, k ∈ ℕ there are N ∈ ℕ and an ℝ-linear isomorphism J from the space Covector (Eucl P) k of k-covectors on ℝ^P onto the Euclidean space EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) such that covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖J α‖ (Euclidean norm) for every k-covector α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ), ∃ (N : ℕ) (J : Covector (Eucl P) k ≃ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), ∀ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖J α‖
